body:
Real page at /admin/mailing-list, mounted alongside the kanban board's own admin surface (S243-08), same cookie-vs-bearer dual entry point split. Shows real subscriber count/sync status (new Store.SyncedCount + AdminSummary, PII-free), a Mailchimp settings form reusing S245-03's handlers as-is (no partial update, matching the API's own real constraint), and CSV/JSON export links reusing S245-02's Export. Fixed a real pre-existing dead /admin link on the kanban page. 2 new tests, go test ./... clean, live-verified booting the real binary -- all new routes correctly 401 without a session cookie, no panics. Commit c6fcf41. Closes out the full S245 chain (S245-01 through S245-05).

⚓ ☃
title: S245-04: real settings page for the mailing-list vault, shipped in IDUNA_PRO's admin surface
